candidate_selection.reason: Original fixed corpus gate passes85 to85/450 under explicit cardinal reconstruction. Supplemental native diagnostic is negative vs linear72 to78/255 but improves deployed79 to78. Fresh holdout was not inferred before this decision. Kaiser is ineligible under fixed zero-delta gate; no post-holdout tuning is permitted.

corpus.name: fono-voxforge-native48-final-holdout-v2
corpus.selection: All ten archive utterances from each of two new named submitters vad and hchauhan, different from prior diagnostic speakers gav and icern300. Chosen only by native 48kHz metadata, archive availability and total14,752,963bytes size, before any STT inference on these recordings. No recognition results or transcript difficulty used for selection. Previous twenty utterances remain diagnostic and are not removed.
corpus.license_separation: Public VoxForge audio/transcripts are GPL-3.0-or-later as declared on the original submission pages; they are separate data from MIT Fono code. Audio and archives remain build-only. Read and retain the archive license notices independently.
corpus.limitations: Twenty utterances from two male speakers. Catalog-declared 48k capture verified as PCM16 mono48k WAV headers, not a claim of measured microphone analog bandwidth, demographic coverage or owner microphone acceptance. HTTP transport hashes are local pins rather than upstream authenticated checksums.

method: Each unchanged native PCM16 mono48k WAV is converted independently by the same production converter using legacy or current and explicit --native-input. No 16→48 reconstruction; exact complete references and all twenty preselected clips retained. Fresh CPU model per alternative; first utterance measured once before its warm replay. Timings observational; unrelated host load uncontrolled.

entries.text: Скайль тоже теперь прищурися, а гряносал дата спыхнул гнёна и пошел по направлению к ниве шагалу верена и широко.
На куча писку 1 сьн с квери. Видимо уже давно. Сидел маленький мальчик грязный рубашки кашку и бештану.
В руке он держал конец верёчки, к другому концу верёчки была привязану за ногу. Старая злохмаченная варона.
Мальчик варона, пустые дома, пустыные улицы, странные взгляды прохожах и приколоченные огвоздиками объявления, кто-то завёт лететь из этого города, в Звездном пустыне.
Развернул план Петербурга и водя по нему концом трубки, а ты скалошь дановскую набережную.
небольшая дверца в ней была приотворена. На пороге сидел на корточках рабочий и размешал видеорке кирпично красный сурик.
На вопрос скайльса, здесь ли можно видеть инженера Лася, рабочий кивнул в внутрь сарае.
Сарая два была священ, над столом, заваленом чертежами и книгами, горелая ликторическая лампочка в жистенном конусе.
Сквозь балки лесов, паблюзки в амметаллическое с часток локой поверхность ферличского тела.
Сквозь раскрытые половинки ворот, были видны, богровые полосы заката и клубы тучи, поднявшийся сморя.
Even Jeff's biggest detractors wouldn't have wanted him to walk out the dough. One loyalist admits.
Please call if you need further documentation.
We have already been in touch with several employers and many are interested in our alumni.
I am sending you the files again just in case you didn't receive them or couldn't open them.
Members are recognized at a dinner hosted by the United Way.
Do you want to go ahead and set up central time to trade? Please let me know.
Mom said that she might want to fix Nuru's soup on Mother's Day. That would be great.
I will be relocating effective December 4th. Can you have me set up with all the required equipment including PC, Telephone and cell phone?
We can go out of town. I would love to get away. Have you heard about Hilton in Austin?
Can you also find out how often they update the capacity and whether they remove the maintenance rate at the time when they come up with the capacity number?
